The renderer never works round an oodWeb defect silently: any work-round is written down where the defect is. The runner stages ooDialog.cls, oodWeb.cls and ooShapes.cls beside the program; that began as a srcDir work-round and stays because it is how the page lays out /home/rexx.

summary: The Qt chat does not change oodWeb.cls. It proposes changes to the ooDialog/WASM chat through Tom, each one tested on a staged copy against named samples. Taken: .application~srcDir is the program's directory, not oodWeb.cls's (proposed in v0.3.0, taken in oodialog-wasm v0.13.0); msSleep takes events only on the thread that runs pumpUntilFinished (proposed in v0.4.0 after up/oowalker hung about one run in six; taken in v0.13.1); tab_calcRect, change (2) below, taken in its own form in v0.19.0 (calcDisplayRect keeps the rectangle given, using tab.outer). Open: changes (1), (3) and (4), as proposals/oodWeb-v0.19.0-linux.patch, which applies to v0.19.0 (ee4b515) and, with line offsets only, to v0.21.0 (be78d99): none of the three was taken in v0.20.0 or v0.21.0. proposals/oodWeb-v0.13.1-linux.patch held all four and applied unchanged from v0.13.1 to v0.18.0: (1) needProvider asks .js~resourceProvider when no reader was set, so the renderer can offer alchemy's oorexx_win_resources; (2) tab_calcRect keeps the coordinates it is given (calcDisplayRect is TCM_ADJUSTRECT), because answering in client coordinates put the TabDemo pages up and to the left of the tab; (3) BinaryMenuBar~new(.nil, id) makes an empty menu bar, as upstream does; (4) il_handle uses numeric digits 20, because identityHash is 64-bit on a 64-bit interpreter. With the patch, 6 more upstream samples come up: oowalk2, both TabDemos, BinaryMenuBar, employe9menuDyn and Exercise04's ASimpleDialog2. It was tested on the Qt renderer only, not in the browser.
title: Changes proposed to oodWeb.cls, and what became of them
